A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
feature selection does not always guarantee better performance in sentiment based classification.
feature selection does play an important role for sentiment analysis and it is a critical task to select representative features.

feature selection is an important task for improving the performance of sentimental text classification, but the performance of the classification depends on the number of feature and the method adopted for feature selection.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of sentiment analysis depends on both the feature selection method and the classifier used.
there is no one size fit all solution to sentiment analysis.
the feature selection and classification techniques are not independent of each other.
